pages.title: Pattern-weavers
text: “A factory is a song that has stopped needing the singer.”

pages.title: Who they are
text: The Pattern-weavers wrote their timings on clock-wheels and moth dust and let the Loom carry the tune. When the Cut came, their songs kept playing. Their craft is **timed songs and automation**.
Their camps stand in **birch forests**, and a second camp keeps the old road in the March crystal fields.

pages.title: What they want
text: Their reagent is the **Storm Wing**, worth **+8** standing at their hearth.
They also favour Redstone, a Clock, a Repeater or a Comparator: **+3** each. Any other food is worth **+1**, and a charged Pulse Cell **+2 for every 10 Pulse**, up to +8.
Remember the hearth takes at most **60** standing a day from offerings; see [Tribes and standing](standing).

pages.title: What the Elder trades
text: **Guest**: 8 Redstone for 2 Echo Shards; a Clock for 4 Repeaters.
**Friend**: 2 Attuned Echo for 4 Comparators; 16 Redstone for a Storm Wing.
**Kin**: 3 Bound Echo for a Lattice Conductor; 2 Bound Echo for a Wind Harp.

pages.title: Their Mark and totem
text: At **Voice** the Elder gives you the Pattern-weavers' Tribe Mark. Craft it with a {item:tribalpower:resonance_totem_air} and two Spiritweave into their [Kinship Totem](kinship_totem).
Beside a Pulse Resonator it is one more voice; beside a station it lends **Air**.
The Pattern-weavers are the only tribe that sells a **Wind Harp**, the Air generator.
Kin of the Pattern-weavers carry their [boon](tribe_boons): Echo stations within 8 blocks of you work at **double speed**.
